content: Neha Chauhan expressed anxiety regarding a delay in the renewal of her health policy (HP-123456) and requested an update. Karan Joshi apologized and informed her that due to processing delays, the policy was currently marked as expired in the system. Karan assured her that he is working to resolve the issue promptly and will ensure her coverage is reinstated.

action_items: Resolve the policy expiration issue in the system
Keep the customer updated on the progress
